title: Expense entry CRUD
description: Log an expense per hostel: category (wifi/water/electricity/tax/maintenance/repair/other), amount, date, recurring flag, note.
acceptanceCriteria: All categories from DESIGN.md are selectable
Recurring flag is stored and editable

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting, ahead of LODGY-22 (monthly report) since that ticket needs real expense data to be meaningful. No bottom-nav tab exists for Expenses yet, so building a minimal More-tab menu screen as the entry point (the More tab has been a placeholder since LODGY-3) - it'll gain more entries as Backup/Restore and Settings tickets land.

Built ExpenseRepository (create/update, both carrying updatedAt), ExpenseListScreen (total-for-hostel header card, list with recurring badge, reactively scoped to the active hostel via flatMapLatest so switching hostels updates the list), ExpenseFormScreen (all 7 ExpenseCategory values as FlowRow filter chips - AC1 - amount, date picker, recurring Switch - AC2 - optional note; shared add/edit). Also built ui/more/MoreScreen.kt and wired the More tab to it (was a placeholder since LODGY-3) with one entry, Expenses, as the way in. Every LodgyDestination now has real content behind it, so LodgyNavHost's per-destination `when` is exhaustive - deleted the now-fully-unused PlaceholderScreen.kt. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, no warnings after fixing an ExperimentalCoroutinesApi opt-in on flatMapLatest.
